{"code":"import random

def vary(example, rng):
    # Preserve the diagonal three-colour stencil while varying its size and colours.
    h = rng.randint(4, 12)
    w = rng.randint(4, 12)
    # Keep the three distinct colours, but permute their roles occasionally.
    pal = [9, 8, 4]
    rng.shuffle(pal)
    g = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    g[0][0] = pal[0]
    # Two neighboring descending diagonals, clipped to the rectangle.
    # Anchor them at the upper-right edge as in the example.
    for r in range(h):
        c = w - 1 - r
        if 0 <= c < w and not (r == 0 and c == 0):
            g[r][c] = pal[1]
        c2 = w - r
        if 0 <= c2 < w and not (r == 0 and c2 == 0):
            g[r][c2] = pal[2]
    return g
"}
